characters.name: Yonatan
characters.description: Little boy about 4, small and round, light tan skin, soft curly black hair, big shining dark eyes, chubby cheeks, short-sleeved mustard-yellow linen tunic to the knees with a thin rope belt, small sandals; signature item: a tiny clay bead on a string around his neck.

characters.name: Abba
characters.description: Yonatan's father, about 35, tall and strong, olive skin, short black beard, warm laughing brown eyes, cream wool tunic with a brown-and-white striped cloak, a white head cloth with a dark cord, sandals.

characters.name: Moshe
characters.description: Very old man of about 120, slender, long flowing white beard and white hair, kind tired brown eyes, warm olive skin, simple light cream linen robe with a sand-colored sash, plain undyed head cloth, sandals, holds a tall plain wooden shepherd's staff. No glow or rays around his head.

characters.name: Naama
characters.description: Little girl about 4, tiny, warm brown skin, two puffy black pigtails tied with blue strings, tearful big dark eyes, long-sleeved sky-blue linen dress to the ankles, barefoot.

characters.name: Naama's mother
characters.description: Woman about 30, slim, warm brown skin, hair covered by a long sky-blue head cloth, long sand-colored robe, worried then joyful face.

cover.prompt: A huge gathering of the whole people of Israel stands together on a desert plain in warm morning light: grandparents, parents, children and babies, tents behind them. In the center foreground, little Yonatan sits high on Abba's shoulders, beaming, while far ahead old Moshe stands on a low rise addressing everyone. Wide, warm, sense of belonging.

pages.prompt: Wide panoramic view of the entire people standing together on a sandy plain: grandmothers and grandfathers, mothers holding babies, older children, families side by side. Among all of them, small Yonatan stands holding Abba's hand, looking around with wonder. Soft golden morning light, endless friendly faces.

Low camera at Yonatan's height: he stands on tiptoes surrounded by a forest of grown-ups' robes and knees, seeing nothing else. He tugs at Abba's cloak with a frustrated, comic face, looking up. Humorous, cozy framing, warm colors. Sandals, robe hems and walking sticks fill the frame around him, while a sliver of blue sky peeks far above.

Abba lifts Yonatan onto his shoulders. From up high, over the sea of heads, Yonatan finally sees Moshe standing in front of the whole people, arms open, speaking. Over-the-shoulder view from behind Yonatan, his delighted face turned in profile, bright sky.

Yonatan on Abba's shoulders leans down and whispers into his father's ear, pointing at himself questioningly. Abba looks up at him with a warm smile and nods. Around them, other small children also sit on shoulders or in arms. Close-medium shot, tender father-son moment.

Yonatan looks up worriedly at the vast blue sky, imagining something enormous and far away: in a soft dream, a closed Torah scroll with plain wooden handles floats very high among the clouds, impossibly tall. Yonatan seems tiny beside the dream. Abba listens with concern. Soft pastel sky, gentle mood.

Moshe speaks warmly to the people, one hand on his heart and the other gesturing gently to the crowd. In a soft dreamy image the scroll floats down from the sky, smaller and closer, settling near Yonatan, glowing gently near his heart. Yonatan's eyes widen in surprise and joy. Warm golden light.

Funny close-up: Yonatan opens his mouth wide, pointing at it, and then puts his hand on his chest over his heart. Abba laughs heartily, explaining with a kind face. Bright light, playful expressions, simple background of the crowd blurred. Around them the friendly crowd stands softly blurred, a few nearby grown-ups smiling at the little boy.

Yonatan has climbed down from Abba's shoulders. Beside him stands little Naama crying, lost among the tall grown-ups. Yonatan reaches out his hand to her with a kind, brave expression. Abba watches from just behind. Low child's-eye view, gentle and caring.

Naama runs into her mother's arms in a big joyful hug, her mother kneeling with tears of relief. Yonatan stands nearby with a warm proud glow on his face, hand on his tummy, looking up at Abba, who smiles proudly. Warm sunlight, happy reunion.

Evening at the edge of the camp. Abba and Yonatan sit together on a rock, watching the thin sliver of a new moon rising over the desert hills, a ram's horn shofar resting on Abba's lap. Yonatan counts good deeds on his fingers with a thoughtful face. Deep purple-blue sky, peaceful, new beginnings.

A long, long line of people holding hands stretches across the plain and over the hills, hand in hand. Right in the middle, little Yonatan holds Abba's hand on one side and Naama's hand on the other, a crucial link in the line. Wide panoramic shot, golden light, joyful unity.

Close, warm portrait of Yonatan smiling directly at the viewer, one hand by his mouth and the other on his heart, a soft warm glow around his chest. Behind him the camp and families are softly blurred in sunset colors. Inviting, encouraging, child-sized and personal.
